svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Key to the worksheet’s symbols
svg.desc: Key. Five supply-layer glyphs from land, power and shell to placement, with the standard and high-memory machine blocks; five stage circles filling from Intent to Organic; timeline marks for commit point, need date, ready for service, cautious lead time, range still open and actual; the firm, flexible and named slices; option, bridge and named-gap marks; numbered method-step pills; and badges for product team, shared service, finance, supply chain and planning.
